questions.question: Normal bone remodelling in response to stress was described by:
questions.explanation: Wolff law states that bone remodels in response to the stresses placed on it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essential Orthopedics/Maheshwari/3rd Ed./Pg. 8

questions.question: A therapist observes that a patient has an exaggerated heel strike on the left during ambulation activities. Which term is most consistent with heel strike using Rancho Los Amigos nomenclature?
questions.explanation: Rancho Los Amigos names the heel strike phase initial contact.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 443

questions.question: A therapist completes a gait analysis on a patient diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. As part of the examination the therapist measures the distance between right heel strike and the next consecutive left heel strike. The measurement is used to measure:
questions.explanation: Distance from the right heel strike to the next left heel strike is the left step length.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: F.A Davis/Norkin/3rd Ed/Pg. 445

questions.question: MCP flexion range in index finger is:
questions.explanation: Index finger MCP flexion is about 90 degrees and rises progressively toward the little finger.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: The primary defect in flat foot is the following:
questions.explanation: Flat foot (pes planus) is collapse of the medial longitudinal arch.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Femoral retroversion leads to:
questions.explanation: Femoral retroversion (reduced anteversion) produces lateral rotation of the limb and a toe-out gait.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: During bilateral stance, shifting of the pelvis to the right side will result in:
questions.explanation: Shifting the pelvis to the right during bilateral stance loads the right side so the left side of the pelvis drops.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Which is the most congruent joint in the human body?
questions.explanation: The ankle (talocrural) joint is the most congruent joint in the body.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Hand to knee gait is also called:
questions.explanation: Hand-to-knee (quadriceps) gait occurs with quadriceps weakness; the hand pushes the thigh to keep the knee extended.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Waddling gait is due to:
questions.explanation: Waddling gait results from weakness of the hip abductors and extensors (gluteal muscles), usually bilateral.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: In pes cavus the subtalar joint goes _______ for position.
questions.explanation: In pes cavus the subtalar joint tends to be supinated (varus).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Posterior tilting of the pelvis, upward movement of symphysis pubis and movement of sacrum close to the pelvis produces _______ at hip.
questions.explanation: Posterior pelvic tilt moves the pubic symphysis up and produces hip extension.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Loading response occurs until:

options.B: Initial contact of the opposite limb
options.C: Opposite limb lifts off the ground

questions.explanation: Loading response begins at initial contact and ends when the opposite limb lifts off (start of single-limb support).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: A typical BOS in walking is about:
questions.explanation: Normal base of support in walking is about 2-4 inches (5-10 cm).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Lubrication created when nonparallel opposing surfaces slide on one another:
questions.explanation: Hydrodynamic lubrication occurs when non-parallel surfaces slide and a fluid wedge forms between them.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: The linear distance between two successive point of contact of opposite limbs is:
questions.explanation: Step length is the distance between the heel strikes of opposite feet.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Stress strain curve of a bone demonstrates that cortical bone is stiffer than:
questions.explanation: Cortical bone is stiffer than cancellous bone and fails at lower strain.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: During swing phase of gait, GRF is:
questions.explanation: During swing phase the foot is off the ground so there is no ground reaction force.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: In toddlers COG is _____ than adults.
questions.explanation: A toddler's centre of gravity is relatively higher, so a wider base of support is needed for stability.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: 50% of body weight is by:
questions.explanation: The trunk makes up about half of total body weight.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Anterior pelvic tilt is produced by:

options.C: Hip adductors and trunk side flexors

questions.explanation: Anterior pelvic tilt is produced by hip flexors and lumbar extensors.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Therapeutic Exercise Foundation/Kisner/ 5th Ed./Pg. 646

questions.question: When there is a permanent deformation with a load of low magnitude and long duration in the elastic range it is known as:
questions.explanation: Creep is progressive deformation of a viscoelastic material under constant load over time.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent & in Rehabilitation/2nd Ed./Pg.123

questions.question: At rest scapula makes an angle of about how much with frontal plane:
questions.explanation: At rest the scapula lies about 30 degrees anterior to the frontal plane (scapular plane).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/ 4th Ed./Pg. 242

questions.question: Increase in torsion angle of femur is referred to as ___________.
questions.explanation: Increased femoral torsion (angle between neck and condylar axis) is femoral anteversion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkins/ 3rd Edition/Pg 323

questions.question: Knee flexion in prone lying is an example of:
questions.explanation: Knee flexion against resistance with the hamstrings is a third-class lever (effort between fulcrum and load).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference:  Joint Structure and Function/Norkins/3rd Ed./Pg. 30

questions.question: The hip musculature involves several muscle groups for different actions. Hip abduction takes place with nerve innervation from the superior gluteal nerve. Which muscles compose the hip abductor group?

options.B: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus, tensor fasciae latae

questions.explanation: The hip abductors are gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae (superior gluteal nerve).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Therapeutic Exercise/Kisner/5th Ed./Pg. 672

questions.question: Nodding movement of head is the example of ________ order lever.
questions.explanation: Nodding the head at the atlanto-occipital joint is a first-class lever (fulcrum between effort and load).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 28

questions.question: Stair climbing requires approximately knee flexion:
questions.explanation: Stair ascent needs about 85-90 degrees of knee flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 467

questions.question: Which class is lever of power:
questions.explanation: Second-class levers favour force (power) while third-class levers favour speed and range of motion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 30

questions.question: Knee extension is limited by _________ .
questions.explanation: Knee extension is limited mainly by tension in the joint capsule and ligaments (screw-home locking).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Therapeutic Exercise Foundation/Kisner/3rd Ed./Pg. 507

questions.question: Quadriceps femoris shows peak force at _________ range.
questions.explanation: Quadriceps torque peaks in the mid-range of knee motion (around 60 degrees).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure of Function/Norkin/ 3rd Ed./Pg. 349

questions.question: During the swing phase, deceleration stage, which muscles contract to slow down the swing phase just prior to heel strike, thus permitting the heel to strike quietly in a controlled manner?
questions.explanation: In terminal swing the hamstrings contract eccentrically to decelerate the leg before heel strike.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed.

questions.question: A patient comes to you status post ankle sprain which is healing well. The patient needs to increase range of motion to resume full activity. Of the following, which movement will take place in the ankle subtalar joint?
questions.explanation: The subtalar joint permits inversion and eversion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essentials of Orhtopaedics and Applied/Jayant Joshi/ 1st Ed./Pg. 555

questions.question: The specific gravity of the human body is
questions.explanation: The specific gravity of the human body is about 0.95.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Mcardle/4th Ed./Pg. 551

questions.question: Normally in the standing position the center of gravity lies:

options.A: 5 cms anterior to second sacral vertebra
options.B: 5 cms posterior to second sacral vertebra
options.D: 5 cms anterior to second lumbar vertebra

questions.explanation: In standing the centre of gravity lies about 5 cm anterior to the second sacral vertebra.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 10

questions.question: Vector is a physical force that has:

options.D: Fixed point of application of force

questions.explanation: A vector has both magnitude and direction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 7

questions.question: In the second order lever the arrangement is:

options.A: Weight in middle, fulcrum and effort point are either end
options.B: Fulcrum is in middle, weight and effort point are on either end
options.C: Effort point is in middle, weight and fulcrum are on either end

questions.explanation: In a second-class lever the weight lies between fulcrum and effort.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 28

questions.question: The body's center of gravity in an adult normally has up and down movements of:
questions.explanation: In walking the centre of gravity rises and falls about 2.5 inches (5 cm).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 449

questions.question: If a plumb line is positioned laterally to a patient so it runs along the line of gravity, where should the line fall with respect to the midline of the knee?
questions.explanation: The line of gravity passes slightly anterior to the knee axis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 412

questions.question: Which type of contraction occurs when the force of the muscles is less than the resistance?
questions.explanation: Eccentric contraction occurs when muscle force is less than the resistance and the muscle lengthens.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Principles of Exercise Therapy/Gardiner/4th Ed./Pg. 22

questions.question: Minimum intradiscal pressure in vertebral column is seen when a person is:
questions.explanation: Intradiscal pressure is lowest when lying flat.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assessment/Magee/5th Ed./Pg. 523

questions.question: Tightness of tensor fascia latae causes:
questions.explanation: A tight tensor fasciae latae/iliotibial band pulls the knee into valgus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 311

questions.question: The ligaments of the hip are very weak:
questions.explanation: The hip capsule is weakest posteriorly.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 298

questions.question: Normal angle between vertical lines of femur and tibia is:
questions.explanation: The normal femorotibial (tibiofemoral) angle is about 7 degrees valgus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 450

questions.question: The main dorsiflexor of foot is:
questions.explanation: Tibialis anterior is the main dorsiflexor.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Kinesiology of Musculoskeletal System/Neuman/Pg. 510

questions.question: A physical therapist observes a patient ambulating with a Trendelenburg gait pattern. This deviation is often caused by weakness of the:
questions.explanation: Trendelenburg gait results from weakness of gluteus medius (with gluteus minimus).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 317

questions.question: A physical therapist observes that a patient's medial longitudinal arch is extremely depressed. Which ligament helps to maintain the medial longtitudnal arch?
questions.explanation: The plantar calcaneonavicular (spring) ligament is a key static support of the medial longitudinal arch.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 399

questions.question: A patient rehabilitating from greater trochanteric bursitis completes active range of motion exercises. Which of the following best describes the arthrokinematics associated with hip flexion?

options.A: Superior glide of the femoral head
options.B: Anterior glide of the femoral head
options.C: Inferior glide of the femoral head in the acetabulum
options.D: Posterior and inferior glide of the femoral head in the acetabulum

questions.explanation: In hip flexion the convex femoral head spins and glides posteriorly (posteroinferiorly) in the acetabulum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 301

questions.question: A physical therapist observes a patient dragging his toe during the swing phase of gait. All of the following are possible causes except:
questions.explanation: Toe drag in swing is caused by weak dorsiflexors, plantar-flexor spasticity or inadequate knee flexion; plantar-flexor weakness is not a cause.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 478

questions.question: A therapist attempts to determine if a patient has muscular weakness in the gastrocnemius or soleus by observing the patient's gait. Which objective finding would not be consistent with weakness in this area?

options.A: Inability to dorsiflex the ankle during midswing phase
options.B: Inability to perform a calf raise against resistance
options.C: Inability to walk on toes decreased toe off

questions.explanation: Inability to dorsiflex in mid-swing is a dorsiflexor problem (foot drop), not triceps surae weakness.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 464

questions.question: The stance phase compromises of the following percentage of gait cycle during normal walking:
questions.explanation: Stance is about 60 percent and swing about 40 percent of the gait cycle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin Pg. 438

questions.question: In high steppage gait there is paralysis of:
questions.explanation: High steppage gait results from paralysis of ankle dorsiflexors (foot drop).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Kinesiology of Musculoskeletal System/Donald. A Neumann/

1st Ed./Pg. 693

questions.question: A therapist completes a gait analysis of a patient rehabilitating from a motor vehicle accident. Which des- criptive term is not associated with the stance phase of the gait cycle?
questions.explanation: Deceleration belongs to the swing phase; heel strike, loading response and mid-stance are stance-phase terms.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 443

questions.question: What muscle controls with position of the ankle joint at heel strike?

options.A: Eccentric contraction of the anterior tibialis
options.C: Concentric contraction of the anterior tibialis

questions.explanation: At heel strike tibialis anterior contracts eccentrically to lower the foot to the ground.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 459

questions.question: A therapist observes a patient walking at various speeds. Which of the following does not occur as the speed of ambulation increases?

options.C: Width of the base of support decreases

questions.explanation: As walking speed increases stride length and cadence increase and the base of support narrows; toe-out angle does not increase.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 446

questions.question: A physical therapist notes during a gait examination that a patient plantar flexes from neutral to 15 degrees as the lower extremity moves from initial contact to then of the loading response. This is indicative of:
questions.explanation: About 15 degrees of plantar flexion from initial contact to the end of loading response is the normal pattern.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 440

questions.question: A therapist observes the gait of a patient of post pneumonia. The therapist notices that the patient walks on his heels. Possible causes of this deviation include all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Heel walking arises from weak plantar flexors (calcaneal gait), tight dorsiflexors or pes calcaneus; weak dorsiflexors do not cause it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 478

questions.question: A therapist views a videotape which compares and contrasts the normal gait of toddlers and adults. Which of the following statements is not accurate when comparing the gait of these two groups?

options.A: Toddlers walk with a wider base of support
options.B: Toddlers walk with an increased single leg support time
options.C: Toddlers walk with a higher cadence
options.D: Toddlers walk with a shorter step length

questions.explanation: Toddlers have a decreased, not increased, single-limb support time compared with adults.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 472

questions.question: Most sensitive structure in a joint is:
questions.explanation: The fibrous capsule is richly supplied with sensory nerve endings and is the most pain-sensitive joint structure; articular cartilage has none.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 70
